info.name: Amazon S3 Control API
Access Points
Amazon S3 Get Access Point

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the access point, or the ARN of the access point for S3 on Outposts.

items.docs: Returns configuration information about the specified access point. All Amazon S3 on Outposts REST API requests for this action require an additional parameter of x-amz-outpost-id to be passed with the request.

info.name: Amazon S3 Create Access Point

params.name: name
params.description: The name you want to assign to this access point.

items.docs: Creates an access point and associates it with the specified bucket. You can use access points to manage access to shared data sets. Access points simplify managing data access at scale for applications using shared data sets on S3.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Access Point

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the access point you want to delete.

items.docs: Deletes the specified access point. All Amazon S3 on Outposts REST API requests for this action require an additional parameter of x-amz-outpost-id.

info.name: Amazon S3 List Access Points

params.name: bucket
params.description: The name of the bucket whose associated access points you want to list.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A continuation token. If a previous call produced a truncated list, pass this value to get the next page of results.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of access points to return (1-1000).

items.docs: Returns a list of the access points that are associated with the specified bucket. You can retrieve up to 1000 access points per call.

info.name: Amazon S3 Get Access Point Policy

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the access point.

items.docs: Returns the access point policy associated with the specified access point.

info.name: Amazon S3 Put Access Point Policy

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the access point.

items.docs: Associates an access policy with the specified access point. Each access point can have only one policy, so a request made to this API replaces any existing policy associated with the specified access point.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Access Point Policy

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the access point.

items.docs: Deletes the access point policy for the specified access point.

info.name: Batch Operations
Amazon S3 List Batch Operations Jobs

params.name: jobStatuses
params.description: The List Jobs request returns jobs that match the statuses listed.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A pagination token to request the next page of results.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: The maximum number of jobs to return.

items.docs: Lists current S3 Batch Operations jobs as well as the jobs that have ended within the last 30 days for the AWS account making the request.

info.name: Amazon S3 Create Batch Operations Job

items.docs: Creates an S3 Batch Operations job to perform the specified operation on every object in the specified manifest. You can create a job that performs PUT copy, invoke an AWS Lambda function, initiate S3 Glacier restore, replace tagging, delete objects, or replicate objects.

info.name: Amazon S3 Describe Batch Operations Job

params.name: id
params.description: The ID for the job whose information you want to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves the configuration parameters and status for a Batch Operations job. For more information, see S3 Batch Operations in the Amazon S3 User Guide.

info.name: Amazon S3 Update Job Priority

params.name: id
params.description: The ID for the job whose priority you want to update.

params.name: priority
params.description: The priority you want to assign to this job.

items.docs: Updates an existing S3 Batch Operations job's priority. You can use this operation to increase or decrease the priority of a job. Higher number priorities are processed first.

info.name: Amazon S3 Update Job Status

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the job whose status you want to update.

params.name: requestedJobStatus
params.description: The status that you want to move the specified job to.

params.name: statusUpdateReason
params.description: A description of the reason why you want to change the job status.

items.docs: Updates the status for the specified job. Use this action to confirm that you want to run a job or to cancel an existing job.

info.name: Public Access Block
Amazon S3 Get Public Access Block

items.docs: Retrieves the PublicAccessBlock configuration for an AWS account. For using this operation with S3 on Outposts, you must provide the Outpost bucket ARN.

info.name: Amazon S3 Put Public Access Block

items.docs: Creates or modifies the PublicAccessBlock configuration for an AWS account. To use this operation, you must have the s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock permission.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Public Access Block

items.docs: Removes the PublicAccessBlock configuration for an AWS account. For this operation, you must have the s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock permission.

info.name: Storage Lens
Amazon S3 List Storage Lens Configurations

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A pagination token for the next page of results.

items.docs: Gets a list of Amazon S3 Storage Lens configurations. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:ListStorageLensConfigurations action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Get Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration.

items.docs: Gets the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:GetStorageLensConfiguration action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Put Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration.

items.docs: Puts an Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:PutStorageLensConfiguration action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Storage Lens configuration to delete.

items.docs: Deletes the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:DeleteStorageLensConfiguration action.

info.name: Access Grants
Amazon S3 Get Access Grants Instance

items.docs: Retrieves the S3 Access Grants instance. You must have the s3:GetAccessGrantsInstance permission to use this operation.

info.name: Amazon S3 Create Access Grants Instance

items.docs: Creates an S3 Access Grants instance, which serves as a logical grouping for access grants. You can create one S3 Access Grants instance per Region per account.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Access Grants Instance

items.docs: Deletes the S3 Access Grants instance. You must first delete all access grants and registered locations before you can delete the S3 Access Grants instance.

info.name: Multi-Region Access Points
Amazon S3 Create Multi-region Access Point

items.docs: Creates a Multi-Region Access Point and associates it with the specified buckets. Multi-Region Access Points provide a single global endpoint that applications can use to request data regardless of the location of the requester. This is an asynchronous request.

info.name: Amazon S3 List Multi-region Access Points

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A pagination token for the next page of results.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Number of results to return per call.

items.docs: Returns a list of the Multi-Region Access Points currently associated with the specified AWS account.

info.name: Amazon S3 Get Multi-region Access Point

params.name: mrap_name+
params.description: The name of the Multi-Region Access Point.

items.docs: Returns configuration information about the specified Multi-Region Access Point.
